title: Spanish Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish originating from the Valencia region, typically made with rice, vegetables, and seafood.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the Spanish vegetables and cook until they start to soften.
Add the broth, rice, paprika, and salt. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with lemon wedges.
